title: ComponentRecord
description: Blueprint v3.1 §4.1: stable chemical identity, elemental composition where known, molecular weight, parameter data and provenance. A pseudo-component has no elemental formula; ADR 0001 requires it to say so explicitly with `elemental_composition: null` and `elemental_verification: NOT_APPLICABLE`, which limits the verification scope rather than hiding it (blueprint §4.2, plan §3.1).

id.description: Stable identity within the revision's component set. Ordering of the component set fixes the order of component molar flow vectors (ADR 0001 D2.1).

synthetic.description: True for an artificial pseudo-component with no chemical identity. SYN-001 sets it true; nothing about such a component is an experimental claim.

identifiers.description: Real chemical identifiers (CAS, InChI, ...). Absent for synthetic components; a synthetic component must not be given one (plan §3.1).

molecular_weight.description: kg/mol. The only route from the amount basis to the mass basis; there is no independent mass state (ADR 0001 D1.4).

elemental_verification.description: Whether A N = 0 elemental accounting is possible for this component (blueprint §4.2). NOT_APPLICABLE is mandatory when there is no elemental formula.

parameters.description: Named model parameters, each a Quantity that must carry its own provenance (blueprint §4.1 'parameter data and provenance').

rights.description: Data rights for this record (blueprint §15, requirement D04). Unresolved rights are stated, never assumed.
